title: Moroccan Bissara Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful fritter filled with vibrant Moroccan chickpea dip, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine bissara, mozzarella, vibrant, flaky, moroccan, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
2. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
3. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
4. When the oil is hot, add the patties and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
5. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Serve the Moroccan Bissara Fritters hot and enjoy!
